engine.role.GK.goalkeeper.label: Goalkeeper
engine.role.GK.goalkeeper.desc: Focuses on keeping the ball out of the net.
engine.role.GK.sweeperKeeper.label: Sweeper Keeper
engine.role.GK.sweeperKeeper.desc: Plays high to sweep up behind the defence and joins the build-up. Needs good feet and decision-making.
engine.role.CB.centreBack.label: Central Defender
engine.role.CB.centreBack.desc: Holds position and stops the opposition forwards.
engine.role.CB.ballPlayingDefender.label: Ball-Playing Defender
engine.role.CB.ballPlayingDefender.desc: Opens up play from the back with forward passes, at a slight cost to defensive focus.
engine.role.CB.stopper.label: Stopper
engine.role.CB.stopper.desc: Steps out to win the ball before the forward can turn. Aggressive, so picks up more cards.
engine.role.LB.fullBack.label: Full-Back
engine.role.LB.wingBack.label: Wing-Back
engine.role.LB.wingBack.desc: Bombs up and down the flank delivering crosses. Leaves space in behind and tires quickly.
engine.role.LB.invertedFullBack.label: Inverted Full-Back
engine.role.LB.invertedFullBack.desc: Tucks inside to add numbers in midfield. Fewer crosses from wide.
engine.role.LB.defensiveFullBack.label: Defensive Full-Back
engine.role.LB.defensiveFullBack.desc: Stays in the back line without overlapping.
engine.role.DM.anchor.label: Anchor
engine.role.DM.deepLyingPlaymaker.label: Deep-Lying Playmaker
engine.role.DM.deepLyingPlaymaker.desc: Dictates play from deep and creates chances with long passes. Offers less defensive cover.
engine.role.DM.ballWinner.label: Ball-Winning Midfielder
engine.role.DM.ballWinner.desc: Hunts the ball aggressively. Covers a lot of ground and picks up more cards.
engine.role.DM.halfBack.label: Half-Back
engine.role.DM.halfBack.desc: Drops between the centre-backs to form a back three. Rarely joins the attack.
engine.role.CM.centralMidfielder.label: Central Midfielder
engine.role.CM.boxToBox.label: Box-to-Box Midfielder
engine.role.CM.boxToBox.desc: Gets up and down between both boxes, contributing at both ends. Physically very demanding.
engine.role.CM.mezzala.label: Mezzala
engine.role.CM.mezzala.desc: Drives into the half-spaces and moves like an extra forward. Leaves gaps behind.
engine.role.CM.deepLyingPlaymaker.label: Deep-Lying Playmaker
engine.role.CM.deepLyingPlaymaker.desc: Drops a little deeper to control the tempo.
engine.role.AM.attackingMidfielder.label: Attacking Midfielder
engine.role.AM.attackingMidfielder.desc: Creates chances behind the attack and gets on the end of them too.
engine.role.AM.advancedPlaymaker.label: Advanced Playmaker
engine.role.AM.advancedPlaymaker.desc: Focuses on the killer pass. Shoots less often.
engine.role.AM.shadowStriker.label: Shadow Striker
engine.role.AM.shadowStriker.desc: Runs into the box from behind the striker to score. A weaker link with midfield.
engine.role.LW.winger.label: Winger
engine.role.LW.winger.desc: Takes on his man down the flank and crosses.
engine.role.LW.insideForward.label: Inside Forward
engine.role.LW.insideForward.desc: Cuts inside to shoot. Fewer crosses.
engine.role.LW.invertedWinger.label: Inverted Winger
engine.role.LW.invertedWinger.desc: Comes inside to create chances for teammates.
engine.role.LW.defensiveWinger.label: Defensive Winger
engine.role.LW.defensiveWinger.desc: Works hard to help out defensively on the flank. Less of an attacking threat.
engine.role.ST.striker.label: Striker
engine.role.ST.striker.desc: Leads the line and focuses on scoring.
engine.role.ST.targetMan.label: Target Man
engine.role.ST.targetMan.desc: Holds the ball up with strength and in the air. More crosses and headers.
engine.role.ST.poacher.label: Poacher
engine.role.ST.poacher.desc: Lurks in the box waiting to finish. Little link-up play.
engine.role.ST.falseNine.label: False Nine
engine.role.ST.falseNine.desc: Drops into midfield to drag defenders out and make space for teammates. Scores less himself.
engine.role.ST.pressingForward.label: Pressing Forward
engine.role.ST.pressingForward.desc: Harries the opposition defence relentlessly. Tires quickly.
